title: 壁付けインターホン
description: 開口したスピーカーグリル、カメラレンズ、無表示画面、呼出ボタンと背面ガスケットを持つ無印インターホン。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: An unbranded entry intercom with real speaker-grille slots, recessed camera lens, blank display, call button and rear mounting gasket. Static nonfunctional prop. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
